Castleton.description: Medium size, slightly oval, purplish blue, greenish-yellow-fleshed freestone ripening in mid August. The flesh is firm and juicy, with good flavor. The tree is upright spreading, vigorous, and productive. It looks very much like Stanley and is best pollinated by Stanley.
